title: 第8212章 上一位元令之人第8211章 有人挑衅
content_zh:
一时间，所有人都惊讶。
所有人都想要看热闹，以为陆安会针锋相对，但完全没想到会是这样的态度。
别说别人没想到，就连这个人也没有想到。
其实很多人都能认出这个人，毕竟是一千年前获得元令的人，也是上一个获得元令的人，大家自然有印象。
不过……
“我记得他现在手里好像没有元令吧？”有人小声对身边的朋友问道。
“对，他没有元令了。”有人说道，“我记得他的元令只维持了三百多年，就没有再给他了。”
“原来如此。”
元令自然不是能够一直拥有，每三年审核一次，谁也不能例外。三百多年，这个时间不算长。只不过即便元令收回，但曾经得到过元令的人还是可以来到这里，没有人会阻拦。大家也会对他与楚天殿内相元境一样的待遇。但……与拥有元令时的待遇，肯定会不一样，下降很多。
毕竟拥有元令，与不拥有元令，截然不同。拥有元令代表顶级天赋，而没有元令就代表没有顶级天赋。
所以，这个人心里十分不平衡。
曾经的他是天之骄子，是整个星河中都十分瞩目的存在。曾经的他也享受与陆安一样的待遇，也像现在一样是所有人的焦点。但现在……一切都不同了。所以当他见到陆安享受这一切，就……十分嫉妒。
他的心中十分不平衡，所以来讥讽。
此人见陆安竟然没有反应，先是一怔，跟着心中更急，认为对方是不把自己放在眼里。
“狂妄什么？你真以为自己能够风光多久？”此人咬牙喝道，“现在所有人都捧你，但用不了多久你就会失去一切！”
陆安的眼神中疑惑更多。
“我知道了，多谢提醒。”陆安说道。
“……”
全场所有人都看着这一幕，更加安静。
大家都错愕，甚至目瞪口呆，难以置信。

这个陆安，还真是好脾气！被人这么挑衅都没有反应，反而还感谢对方。虽然语气很平静，但听起来却十分刺耳，感觉是在阴阳怪气，比破口大骂更有杀伤力。
果然，这个人的脸色顿时变得赤红！
他看向四周，发现有人在小声偷笑，对这里指指点点，很明显是在嘲笑他！
他猛地双拳紧握，眼神发狠，死死盯着陆安！
一双眼中不仅有嫉妒，更有恨意，甚至是杀意！
陆安拥有灵力，自然对杀意感知十分明显。他能清楚感知到对方是真的想杀了自己，让他的黑暗双眼深处微微变化。
这变化，是任何人都看不出的，只有陆安自己知道。
陆安的脾气确实还可以，但不代表有人对自己动了杀心还会好脾气。如果对方只是讥讽自己几句，他不会在意。但既然想杀自己，就是他的敌人。
而且对方的年龄应该不会很大，毕竟获得元令要求年龄在四十岁以内，而对方是一千年前获得，也就是说对方的年龄也就是一千多出头。虽然这个时间看似很长，但如果与相元境无穷无尽的生命相比，确实极其年轻，根本不长。
不知道对方的实力如何，但这里只有天神境，没有星河之主，毕竟是在星河之外，所以……陆安稍微动用黑暗二段感知。
正好他也尝试一下，看这里的天神境是否有能力连接黑暗，是否有能力感知到黑暗。
黑暗二段感知迅速扩散，立刻将整个庭院，整个府邸的所有人都笼罩。
黑暗世界的感知，让任何人的实力都无所遁形。
content_en:
For a moment, everyone was surprised.
Everyone wanted to watch the fun and thought Lu An would be tit for tat, but they didn't expect such an attitude.
Don't say that others didn't think of it, even this person didn't think of it.
In fact, many people can recognize this person. After all, he was the person who obtained the Yuan Order a thousand years ago, and he was also the last person to obtain the Yuan Order. Naturally, everyone has an impression.
But...
"I remember that he doesn't seem to have Yuan Ling in his hand now, right?" Someone asked a friend next to him in a low voice.
"Yes, he no longer has his Yuan Ling." Someone said, "I remember that his Yuan Ling only lasted for more than three hundred years and was not given to him again."
"That's it."
Naturally, Yuan Ling cannot be owned all the time. It is reviewed every three years, and no one can be an exception. More than three hundred years is not a long time. But even if the Yuan Ling is withdrawn, people who have received the Yuan Ling can still come here, and no one will stop them. Everyone will treat him the same as Xiangyuan Realm in Chutian Palace. But... the treatment will definitely be different from when you have Yuan Ling, and will drop a lot.
After all, having Yuan Ling is completely different from not having Yuan Ling. Having Yuan Ling means top talent, but not having Yuan Ling means not having top talent.
Therefore, this person is very unbalanced.
He was once a proud man of heaven, a being that attracted much attention in the entire galaxy. In the past, he enjoyed the same treatment as Lu An, and was the focus of everyone's attention as now. But now...everything is different. So when he saw Lu An enjoying all this, he was...very jealous.
He was very unbalanced in his heart, so he came to ridicule.
Seeing that Lu An didn't respond, this person was startled at first, and then became more anxious, thinking that the other party didn't take him seriously.
"Why are you so arrogant? How long do you really think you can be famous?" The man gritted his teeth and yelled, "Everyone is praising you now, but it won't be long before you lose everything!"
Lu An's eyes were filled with more doubts.
"I understand, thank you for reminding me." Lu An said.
"..."
Everyone in the audience watched this scene and became even quieter.
Everyone was stunned, even dumbfounded and in disbelief.
This Lu An is really good-tempered! He didn't react to being provoked like this, but instead thanked the other person. Although the tone was calm, it sounded very harsh. It felt like he was being angry and more lethal than yelling.
Sure enough, this man's face suddenly turned red!
He looked around and found someone snickering and pointing at this place, obviously laughing at him!
He clenched his fists suddenly, stared at Lu An with fierce eyes!
There was not only jealousy in a pair of eyes, but also hatred and even murderous intent!
Lu An possesses spiritual power, so he naturally senses murderous intent very clearly. He could clearly sense that the other party really wanted to kill him, which caused a slight change in the depths of his dark eyes.
This change cannot be seen by anyone, only Lu An himself knows it.
Lu An's temper is indeed okay, but that doesn't mean that someone who has murderous intentions towards him will still have a good temper. If the other person just makes fun of him, he won't care. But since he wants to kill himself, he is his enemy.
And the other party's age should not be very old. After all, the age required to obtain Yuan Ling is under forty years old, and the other party obtained it a thousand years ago, which means that the other party's age is just over a thousand years old. Although this time seems to be very long, if compared with the endless life of Xiangyuan Realm, it is indeed extremely young and not long at all.
I don’t know what the opponent’s strength is, but there is only the realm of gods here, and there is no Lord of the Galaxy. After all, it is outside the galaxy, so... Lu An slightly uses the second level of dark perception.
It just so happened that he also gave it a try to see if the God Realm here had the ability to connect to the darkness and whether it had the ability to sense the darkness.
The second level of dark perception spread rapidly, immediately covering the entire courtyard and everyone in the entire mansion.
The perception of the dark world makes anyoneThere is no hiding from human strength.
